title: Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.02021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable generalization and reasoning abilities, yet 3D understanding in these models is limited by data scale, training diversity, and reasoning capacity. Instead of naively extending these models into 3D, we take a different approach: we enable powerful 2D VLMs to operate reliably in 3D by introducing 3D grounding and iterative feedback loops with two novel concepts: Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF). CCF serves as a unified visual representation that anchors both inputs and outputs to a shared Euclidean coordinate system, solving common challenges in 3D grounding such as axis ambiguity, inconsistent metric scale, and floating references. Complementary to this structured framing of the 3D inputs, TAF closes the reasoning loop with task-adaptive dynamic feedback that enables 2D VLMs to perform varied open-vocabulary tasks within their native visual contex

translated_title: 基于2D视觉语言模型的任务自适应接地式3D程序生成器
translated_abstract: 近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出卓越的泛化和推理能力，然而这些模型对3D的理解受限于数据规模、训练多样性和推理能力。我们采取了一种不同的方法，而非简单地将这些模型扩展到3D：我们通过引入3D接地和迭代反馈循环，使强大的2D视觉语言模型能够在3D环境中可靠运行，并提出了两个新颖的概念：规范坐标系框架和任务自适应反馈（TAF）。CCF作为一种统一的视觉表示，将输入和输出都锚定到共享的欧几里得坐标系中，解决了3D接地中的常见挑战，如轴向歧义、度量尺度不一致和浮动参考等问题。与这种对3D输入的结构化框架相辅相成，TAF通过任务自适应的动态反馈闭合了推理循环，使2D视觉语言模型能够在它们原生的视觉语境中执行多样化的开放词汇任务。
tldr: 该论文提出通过规范坐标系框架（CCF）和任务自适应反馈（TAF）两个新概念，使强大的2D视觉语言模型无需直接扩展到3D，就能在3D环境中可靠地执行多样化的开放词汇任务。
en_tdlr: This paper enables powerful 2D VLMs to reliably operate in 3D by introducing two novel concepts, Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF), which provide unified 3D grounding and iterative task-adaptive reasoning feedback.
